declaredIdentity: UUIDv5 namespace + tenant/snapshot/index; Store compares kind/digest; one append; one technical record per chunk. Portia appends against the hydrated physical stream position; a logical revision does not create another physical boundary.
invariant: Technical invariant only: one snapshot/index stores one immutable kind+row digest, changed bytes conflict. No independent business decision or lifecycle.
boundaryRationale: Chunking is storage for the snapshot-owned freeze invariant; chunks can be moved to content-addressed storage without losing a business decision if manifest visibility and integrity remain atomic.
logicalPhysicalRule: Logical technical responsibility is separate from physical storage/owner. Existing native operational journals may remain where required for exact recovery; this inventory does not require conversion to KV/CAS or count them as business authority.
